instruction: Action sports photograph, medium-full shot. In a covered outdoor pavilion, the boxer in the beige t-shirt (R1) in the center lunges forward in a wide stance, throwing a powerful right punch. The boxer in the blue tank top (R2) on the right quickly moves away, captured from a three-quarters back view. Bright daylight fills the space, creating a high-key, active atmosphere.
